result.summary:
Approve the diagnostic design only. No substantive product/security or machinery finding beyond the explicitly disclosed residuals. No tenth in-scope redactOnly site found; checked citations resolve.

Executed the real scanner, alert/evidence writers, spawnBrain, runJob and transcript collection with intercepted filesystem/process dependencies. Confirmed the three 24-character truncation leaks, four contiguous whole-credential chunk leaks, and safe controls. Also reproduced both brain-stream leaks through actual subprocess pipes with two observed chunks. All three order-swap mutations discriminate; the literal R1 declaration loads through loadDeclarations.

Positive-presence assertions reject empty artifacts; coalesced chunks fail the defect assertion rather than passing vacuously. Fixture helpers use temporary roots. Failing SAFE assertions can print the synthetic probe into CI diagnostics, but no real credential is involved.

Filesystem permissions prevented independent on-disk reproduction and full gate execution; captured write payloads are not disk-durability verification.
next_steps: During implementation, run all sixteen probes against real temporary files and complete the unfiltered RED-proof, test and lint gates.
